descriptionChirho: The proper noun Καισαρία (Kaisareia) referring to the city of Caesarea, either Caesarea Maritima on the Mediterranean coast (the Roman provincial capital of Judea) or Caesarea Philippi in the north. The two clusters differ only in grammatical case distribution (accusative/dative/genitive 15x vs genitive-only 2x), not in referential meaning. Multilingual rendering is consistent: Spanish 'Kaisáreia/Cesarea,' Hindi 'कैसरिया,' Arabic 'قيصريّة,' Korean '가이사랴/가이사리아,' Swahili 'Kaisaria.' Case variation does not warrant separate lexicographic senses.
